cast.text: Single cute magical talisman throw for a chibi Thai fantasy RPG: a crisp papery flutter and small airy whoosh rising into one bright wooden ranat click. Immediate onset, charming and light, isolated game effect, no voice or music bed.

impact.text: Single playful magical projectile impact: a rounded soft pop and muted wooden thump with a brief shower of sparkling tiny chimes. Cute chibi spirit battle, satisfying but not harsh or frightening, quick clean decay, no voice no background noise or music.

burst.text: One cartoon magical spirit explosion, a low soft poof followed by a sparkling scattered cascade of bamboo and little crystal tinkles. Bigger than a normal hit but gentle and cute. Clean punchy onset, short airy tail, isolated game sound, no voice or music.

heal.text: Healing magic for a cute Thai chibi RPG: a gentle upward ripple of chakhe plucked-string harmonics and warm tiny bells, a soft bamboo-flute breath and sparkling resolve. Pure comforting restorative effect, immediate onset, no voice or background ambience.

shield.text: A small magical protective shield forming, one soft resonant bronze Thai gong ting with a rounded airy bubble swell and delicate crystalline ring. Cute and reassuring, short isolated game sound, no voice no ambience no long music.

victory.text: A joyful three-second ORIGINAL victory jingle for a cute Thai spirit RPG, bright ranat ek wooden xylophone ascending flourish, chakhe plucked zither answer, cheerful tiny gong resolution. Warm triumphant smile rather than epic fanfare, no voices, no orchestral brass, no background noise.

defeat.text: A gentle two-second ORIGINAL try-again game jingle, three descending soft Thai khlui bamboo flute notes with a warm chakhe pluck and tender small gong ending. Cute and encouraging, never sad or scary, no voices, no orchestral instruments or ambient noise.

forge.text: One magical blacksmith enhancement success: two crisp light metal hammer taps then a short bright rising Thai ranat and bell sparkle. Cute fantasy equipment upgrade, compact satisfying game effect, no voice no ambience no continuous music.
